output.reason: A 30-year-old man on finasteride 1mg daily for about a year with no reported side effects needs a clinician prescribing decision for a refill, with no reported features requiring urgent or in-person care.
output.patientMessage: I've routed your finasteride 1mg refill request for Counsel clinician review in this thread; a prescriber needs to approve any renewal. If you notice new breast tenderness or lumps, mood changes, or sexual side effects, message here so a clinician can reassess before you continue the medication.
